title: Enforce C-contiguity on array inputs to NMF coordinate descent
answers: Why does NMF.fit_transform raise 'ValueError: ndarray is not C-contiguous'?
How to fix ndarray is not C-contiguous error in NMF coordinate descent?
Why does NMF fail in _update_cdnmf_fast with non-C-contiguous arrays?
body:
Symptom: NMF.fit or NMF.fit_transform raises ValueError: ndarray is not C-contiguous.
Root cause: sklearn/decomposition/_nmf.py:_fit_coordinate_descent passed array W to Cython routine _update_cdnmf_fast without ensuring C-contiguity for floating[:, ::1].
Fix pattern: Wrap input arrays in np.ascontiguousarray before invoking Cython routines expecting C-contiguous memoryviews, and convert CSC sparse matrices to CSR.
Constraints: Applies to Cython memoryviews requiring contiguous layout ([:, ::1]); unnecessary when Cython accepts strided memoryviews ([:, :]).
applies: NMF coordinate descent solver in sklearn/decomposition
